status_note: IDs, dictionary family, corner layout and printed rotations are VERIFIED from a photo of the physical board (2026-10-18, see docs/BOARD_REGISTRATION.md). Marker centre positions and the board size are PHOTO ESTIMATES (perspective photo, left paper edge cut off) and must be confirmed with a ruler via `python -m perception.service --calibrate`, which rewrites this file with status MEASURED. Until then the service reports registration_verified=false.
frame_note: UV frame = the UPRIGHT printed map (map labels readable, river entering from the top): u to the right, v down, (0,0) at the paper's top-left corner, (1,1) at its bottom-right. The 2026-10-18 photo was taken with the map rotated 90 deg clockwise (portrait); rotate it 90 deg counter-clockwise to get this frame. NOTE FOR SHARED INTEGRATION: this print is landscape (height ~0.76 x width) while the scenario's board frame is a 420x420 square; the print-UV -> world board_uv/geo transform is owned by the shared lane and is NOT the identity.

board.dimensions_source: PHOTO ESTIMATE: aspect height/width = 0.763 measured from the 2026-10-18 photo after rectification; absolute width ASSUMED 594 mm (A-series) only so that mm-based gates have a scale. Replace both numbers with ruler measurements of the paper.

aruco.dictionary_note: Verified: all four printed markers decode in every 4X4 dictionary (50/100/250/1000 share these IDs). DICT_4X4_50 is used because it is the smallest family that contains them, which maximises decoding margin.
aruco.marker_size_note: Not measured. Photo estimate: black square edge = 0.132 x paper height (about 60 mm if the paper is 453 mm tall). Measure it with a ruler and set it here to enable corner-based registration (16 points, partial-occlusion tolerant); null = centres only, all four markers required.
